{{Top|leg}}
A '''jerikan''' was a square-type container used to keep [[Water/Legends|water]] clean and fresh on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
A jerikan appears in ''[[Anakin's Fate]]'', a children's book written by [[Marc Cerasini]]. In real life, [[Wikipedia:Jerrycan|jerrycans]] were containers for [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and water designed by [[Wikipedia:Germmany|Germany]] prior to [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]]. The design was subsequently reverse-engineered and utilized by Germany's enemies, the Allies, and they are still in use by these countries today. Nonetheless, no more than phonetical and functional connections are made in Cerasini's work.
